bugs.title: SSO login loops back to sign-in after successful Okta redirect
bugs.description: Enterprise tenants using Okta are returned to the sign-in screen after the identity provider redirect completes. The session cookie is issued but immediately discarded because the callback handler rewrites the domain attribute. Three tenants have reported full lockout.
stepsToReproduce: Open the app with tenant slug `northwind` and choose Continue with SSO.
Authenticate against Okta with a valid enterprise account.
Wait for the callback redirect to /auth/callback to finish.
Observe that the app returns to the sign-in screen instead of the dashboard.
bugs.expectedResult: The user lands on the dashboard with an active session that survives a page reload.
bugs.actualResult: The callback sets a cookie scoped to the wrong domain, the session is dropped, and the sign-in screen is shown again in a loop.

comments.body: Reproduced on staging with the same tenant. The cookie domain is being set from the request host instead of the configured root domain.
@Aarav Mehta that matches what I see in the HAR file — the Set-Cookie header uses the tenant host on every callback.
Flagging this as the release blocker for 4.18. @Priya Nair please pair with Aarav after standup.

bugs.title: Invoice PDF totals ignore multi-currency tax rounding
bugs.description: Invoices that mix EUR line items with USD credits round tax per line instead of per invoice, so the PDF total differs from the amount charged by up to 0.4%.
stepsToReproduce: Create an invoice with three EUR line items and one USD credit note.
Apply the 19% German VAT tax profile.
Download the invoice PDF from the billing detail page.
Compare the PDF total against the charged amount in the payments table.
bugs.expectedResult: Tax is calculated once on the invoice subtotal and the PDF total matches the charged amount exactly.
bugs.actualResult: Tax is rounded on each line, producing a total that is 0.31 EUR higher than the amount charged.

comments.body: Fix moves rounding to the invoice aggregate. Ready for QA on staging — please re-check the credit note case as well.

bugs.title: Report export worker times out on datasets above 50k rows
bugs.description: Scheduled CSV exports fail silently once a report crosses roughly 50,000 rows. The worker hits the 30 second gateway timeout and the user is never told the export failed.
stepsToReproduce: Open Reporting and select the Quarterly Activity report.
Set the range to the last 12 months so the result exceeds 50k rows.
Trigger Export to CSV and wait for the email.
Check the worker logs for the queued job.
bugs.expectedResult: The export streams to storage and the user receives a download link, regardless of row count.
bugs.actualResult: The worker is killed at 30 seconds, the job is marked complete, and no email or error is delivered.

comments.body: Switching the worker to a streaming cursor and moving it off the request path. Rough shape of the change:

bugs.title: Daily digest email sends twice for users in UTC+13
bugs.description: The digest scheduler buckets users by UTC offset. Offsets greater than +12 wrap to a negative bucket, so those users are enqueued in two windows and receive the digest twice.
stepsToReproduce: Set a test user's timezone to Pacific/Auckland during daylight saving.
Enable the daily digest for that user.
Wait for the 08:00 local scheduler window.
Check the delivery log for that recipient.
bugs.expectedResult: Exactly one digest per user per day.
bugs.actualResult: Two digests are delivered 60 minutes apart.

comments.body: Bucketing now uses the IANA zone instead of the raw offset, which also removes the DST edge case.
Verified on production for three UTC+13 accounts across two days. No duplicates.

bugs.title: Role editor lets an admin remove their own last admin role
bugs.description: The role editor validates role removal on the client only. An org's last administrator can strip their own admin role and lock the whole workspace out of settings.
stepsToReproduce: Sign in as the only administrator of a workspace.
Open User Management and edit your own roles.
Remove the Administrator role and save.
Reload the settings page.
bugs.expectedResult: The save is rejected with an explanation that a workspace must keep at least one administrator.
bugs.actualResult: The change is accepted and settings become unreachable for every member of the workspace.

comments.body: Adding the invariant to the server handler as well, the client guard alone is not enough.

bugs.title: Search returns stale results after a saved filter is renamed
bugs.description: Renaming a saved filter does not invalidate the cached query key, so the results panel keeps rendering the previous filter's hits until a hard refresh.
stepsToReproduce: Save a search filter named `Open critical`.
Rename it to `Open blockers`.
Run the renamed filter from the sidebar.
Compare the result count with a fresh page load.
bugs.expectedResult: The renamed filter runs and returns current results.
bugs.actualResult: The panel shows results cached under the old filter name.

bugs.title: Webhook retries fire without exponential backoff
bugs.description: Failed webhook deliveries retry every two seconds for an hour instead of backing off. Two customers have rate limited our IP range as a result.
stepsToReproduce: Register a webhook endpoint that responds with 500.
Trigger any event that fans out to webhooks.
Watch the delivery attempts in the integration log.
bugs.expectedResult: Retries back off exponentially and stop after the configured attempt budget.
bugs.actualResult: 1,800 attempts are made in the first hour at a fixed 2s interval.

comments.body: Blocked until the queue upgrade lands — the current driver has no delayed-retry support.

bugs.title: KPI cards show NaN while the comparison range is loading
bugs.description: Trend deltas divide by an undefined previous value on first paint, so each card briefly renders `NaN%` before the comparison range resolves.
stepsToReproduce: Throttle the network to Slow 3G.
Open the dashboard with a comparison range enabled.
Watch the four KPI cards during the first second.
bugs.expectedResult: Cards render a skeleton until both ranges have resolved.
bugs.actualResult: Cards render `NaN%` and then correct themselves.

bugs.title: Multi-file upload silently drops files above 25 MB
bugs.description: Selecting several files at once uploads only those under the per-file limit. Oversized files disappear from the queue with no error, so users believe the upload succeeded.
stepsToReproduce: Open any record and start an attachment upload.
Select four files, two of them larger than 25 MB.
Confirm the upload and wait for it to finish.
Reload the record and count the attachments.
bugs.expectedResult: Oversized files are rejected with a visible message naming each file.
bugs.actualResult: Only the two small files appear; the others vanish without a trace.

comments.body: The client filter runs before validation and never reports what it removed. Reopening the error channel now.
Reopened — the message shows for a single oversized file but not when several are rejected at once.

bugs.title: Audit log paginates past the end of the event stream
bugs.description: The audit log cursor does not check for an empty page, so Next stays enabled forever and shows an empty table beyond the last event.
stepsToReproduce: Open the audit log for a workspace with fewer than 50 events.
Click Next twice.
bugs.expectedResult: Next is disabled on the final page.
bugs.actualResult: An empty table is rendered and Next remains clickable.

bugs.title: Onboarding wizard loses progress when the browser is resized
bugs.description: Crossing the tablet breakpoint remounts the wizard because the layout swaps component trees, which resets the in-memory draft to step one.
stepsToReproduce: Start onboarding on an iPad in portrait orientation.
Complete steps one and two.
Rotate the device to landscape.
bugs.expectedResult: The wizard keeps the current step and the entered values.
bugs.actualResult: The wizard restarts at step one with empty fields.

bugs.title: Rate limiter counts preflight requests against the caller quota
bugs.description: CORS preflight OPTIONS requests are metered, so browser clients exhaust roughly half of their quota before sending a single real request.
stepsToReproduce: Call any browser-facing endpoint from a different origin.
Inspect the X-RateLimit-Remaining header across ten calls.
bugs.expectedResult: Only non-preflight requests decrement the quota.
bugs.actualResult: Each call decrements the quota twice.

comments.body: Preflight is now short-circuited before the limiter middleware.

bugs.title: Chart tooltips stay pinned after the pointer leaves the canvas
bugs.description: Leaving the chart quickly through the top edge does not fire a pointer-out event, so the tooltip stays visible over the rest of the page.
stepsToReproduce: Hover any bar in the activity chart.
Move the pointer up and out of the chart in one quick motion.
bugs.expectedResult: The tooltip disappears when the pointer leaves the chart.
bugs.actualResult: The tooltip stays on screen until the next hover.

bugs.title: Password reset link expires after 30 seconds instead of 30 minutes
bugs.description: A unit mix-up between seconds and minutes shortened the reset token lifetime to 30 seconds, so nearly every reset attempt failed with an invalid token error.
stepsToReproduce: Request a password reset email.
Wait one minute, then open the link.
bugs.expectedResult: The link is valid for 30 minutes.
bugs.actualResult: The link is rejected as expired.

comments.body: One-line fix, plus a regression test that asserts the TTL in seconds.

bugs.title: Bulk role assignment applies to filtered-out users
bugs.description: Select-all captures every user in the workspace rather than the current filter, so a bulk role change can hit hundreds of unintended accounts.
stepsToReproduce: Filter User Management to the Support team.
Use the header checkbox to select all rows.
Assign the Billing Admin role in bulk.
Clear the filter and inspect the full user list.
bugs.expectedResult: Only users matching the active filter are changed.
bugs.actualResult: Every user in the workspace receives the role.

bugs.title: Notification preferences reset when the profile drawer closes
bugs.description: Toggling notification switches updates local state but the drawer unmounts before the debounced save flushes, so the changes never reach the server.
stepsToReproduce: Open the profile drawer and switch off two notification types.
Close the drawer within a second.
Reopen the drawer.
bugs.expectedResult: The switches keep their new values.
bugs.actualResult: Both switches are back on.

bugs.title: Search highlights ignore diacritics for Latin scripts
bugs.description: Matching is accent-insensitive but highlighting is not, so results for `Tomas` return the right rows with nothing highlighted for `Tomás`.
stepsToReproduce: Search for `Tomas` without the accent.
Inspect the highlighted spans in the result list.
bugs.expectedResult: The matched substring is highlighted in accented text too.
bugs.actualResult: Rows match but no highlight is rendered.

bugs.title: Dashboard date range picker allows an end date before the start
bugs.description: The range picker accepts an inverted range, which produces an empty result set and a misleading zero on every card.
stepsToReproduce: Open the dashboard date range picker.
Set the start to 1 July and the end to 1 June.
Apply the range.
bugs.expectedResult: The picker refuses an end date earlier than the start date.
bugs.actualResult: The range is applied and every metric reads zero.

bugs.title: Attachment thumbnails fail to load behind the CDN cache
bugs.description: Signed thumbnail URLs are cached by the CDN with their expiry, so after 15 minutes every cached thumbnail returns 403 until the cache is purged.
stepsToReproduce: Upload an image attachment and load the record.
Wait 20 minutes and reload from a different device.
bugs.expectedResult: Thumbnails load for any viewer at any time.
bugs.actualResult: Thumbnails return 403 from the CDN edge.

bugs.title: Audit log export omits the actor column for system events
bugs.description: System-generated events have no actor record, and the exporter writes an empty cell instead of the `system` sentinel used in the UI.
stepsToReproduce: Export the audit log for a range containing scheduled jobs.
Open the CSV and look at the actor column.
bugs.expectedResult: System events export with the actor `system`.
bugs.actualResult: The actor cell is empty.

bugs.title: Integration setup rejects valid API keys containing plus signs
bugs.description: Keys are trimmed with a pattern that also strips `+`, so any key containing one is stored corrupted and every request from it is rejected.
stepsToReproduce: Paste an API key that contains a plus sign into the integration form.
Save and run the connection test.
bugs.expectedResult: The key is stored verbatim and the test passes.
bugs.actualResult: The stored key is missing the plus sign and the test fails.

comments.body: Reopened: `+` is fixed but keys with a trailing `=` are still mangled.

bugs.title: Session stays alive after the user revokes it from another device
bugs.description: Revoking a session removes the database row but the gateway keeps its token in an in-memory cache for up to 15 minutes, leaving the revoked device fully authenticated.
stepsToReproduce: Sign in on two devices.
Revoke the second device's session from security settings.
Continue browsing on the revoked device.
bugs.expectedResult: The revoked device is signed out on its next request.
bugs.actualResult: It keeps working for up to 15 minutes.

comments.body: Publishing a revocation event to the gateway so the cache entry is dropped immediately.

bugs.title: Billing page shows a negative balance for prepaid accounts
bugs.description: Prepaid credit is stored as a negative balance internally but rendered without conversion, so customers with credit appear to owe money.
stepsToReproduce: Open the billing page for an account with prepaid credit.
Read the balance summary.
bugs.expectedResult: Credit is shown as available balance.
bugs.actualResult: The balance reads `-240.00 USD` with an overdue style.

bugs.title: Report scheduler drops the timezone when a schedule is duplicated
bugs.description: Duplicating a schedule copies the cron expression but not the timezone, so the copy runs in UTC.
stepsToReproduce: Create a schedule at 09:00 Europe/Berlin.
Duplicate it and inspect the copy.
bugs.expectedResult: The duplicate keeps the original timezone.
bugs.actualResult: The duplicate runs at 09:00 UTC.

bugs.title: Keyboard focus escapes the modal when tabbing backwards
bugs.description: Shift+Tab from the first focusable element in a modal moves focus to the page behind it instead of wrapping to the last element.
stepsToReproduce: Open any modal.
Press Shift+Tab from the first focusable control.
bugs.expectedResult: Focus wraps to the last focusable element inside the modal.
bugs.actualResult: Focus lands on the page behind the overlay.

bugs.title: Gateway returns 500 instead of 413 for oversized payloads
bugs.description: The body size guard throws before the error mapper runs, so clients see an opaque 500 for a request they could fix themselves.
stepsToReproduce: POST a 12 MB JSON body to any write endpoint.
bugs.expectedResult: 413 Payload Too Large with the configured limit in the body.
bugs.actualResult: 500 Internal Server Error with no detail.
